title: A faster, easier-to-navigate model catalog
summary:
The model catalog got faster and easier to browse, app entries gained screenshots, and long text requests got a less fragile route.

Enter now separates Official and Community models, keeps search terms when switching between them, and loads catalog rows as you scroll. The initial Official view drops from about 17,400 DOM elements to about 2,500. Model lists also get consistent ordering and clearer generation estimates, while Community model branding and forms get a small cleanup.

The public model catalog now shows alternate rates and itemized adjustments for things like search, caching, and realtime input. Image prices distinguish per-generation charges from token rates, including separate input and output image charges where applicable.

The community app catalog moved to validated JSON, giving the website a direct source for new entries. App entries can now include screenshot URLs, which the public directory endpoint returns as `screenshot_url`; seven screenshots were added across eight rows. Whisper, an Android app that uses Pollinations models for screen and audio requests, joined the showcase.

highlights.title: Official and Community models
highlights.text: Browse Official and Community models separately in Enter. Search stays in place when you switch between them. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: A lighter model catalog
highlights.text: The model catalog loads more rows as you scroll instead of rendering the whole list up front, making the initial view lighter. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Screenshots in app directory data
highlights.text: App directory entries can include screenshots. The public directory endpoint returns their URLs as `screenshot_url`, with entries that have no screenshot still supported.
